config.whitening: PCA whitening in the top 64 directions, fitted on the training pool
config.k_means: 128 clusters, k-means++ seeding, 30 iterations, fitted on the whitened training pool
config.gap_masking: 3x3 holes centred on a stride-6 lattice; 36 phases at scoring, centre scored
config.decision_direction: the water head's weight in whitened coordinates, unit norm; |residual . direction|
config.predictors: exp33's architecture; residual (random 25% masks), gap (hole masks, centre loss), cluster (cross-entropy)
config.null: every variant tracks S2 patch variance and the boundary indicator, as exp33's residual did

prereg.combination: U+ = mean of within-scene midrank percentiles of confidence and of the primary score
prereg.note: river-level one-sided exact sign tests are the inference; scene-level W/L/T are descriptive
Bolivia is one flood event; per-tile signs are descriptive, not an exact test
